query: UPDATE tracker_connections SET checkpoint=$3,next_run_at=CASE WHEN NOT $4 THEN clock_timestamp() WHEN $5 THEN clock_timestamp()+interval '30 minutes' ELSE GREATEST(clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds',$6::timestamptz+interval '5 minutes') END,status=$7,last_error='',last_checked_at=CASE WHEN $8 THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE last_checked_at END,last_synced_at=CASE WHEN $4 AND NOT $9 THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE last_synced_at END,poll_watermark=CASE WHEN $4 AND NOT $9 THEN $6 WHEN $4 AND $9 THEN NULL ELSE poll_watermark END,last_discovered_at=CASE WHEN $10 THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE last_discovered_at END WHERE id=$1 AND generation=$2
